question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant on the journey from Sloth Encounters, Hauppauge, NY toward Sculpture Center, Long Island City, NY?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city, p.amenity FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sloth Encounters%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hauppauge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sculpture Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Long Island City%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1) )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
